decision.title: A compile report sink for XSLT (packet )
decision.summary: sxml_xslt_stylesheet_configuration gains a report_sink, a that receives every static and type error of a stylesheet compile while reading and lowering go on; the null sink keeps first-error behaviour.

body.p: , after ("Compile errors", the owner's 7b), and . The header change announced for 7.28.

item.p: Header (additive): include/sxml/xslt.h includes sxml/schema.h and sxml_xslt_stylesheet_configuration gains, at its end, sxml_schema_report_sink report_sink; (XSD's sink type, reused: one report of a compile error, code, description and location, for every language). The null sink, the zero value, keeps the first-error behaviour exactly.

Mechanism (glossary , ): one internal collector (sxml_xslt_error_collector, src/xslt_ast.c) that the reader and lowering write each error into and ask whether to go on. With a sink a static or type error goes there and the work goes on: the reader leaves out the attribute in error (and the element's whole-element checks, which would report what follows from that), or the element when the element itself is wrong, and reads the rest; lowering goes on with the next template rule, stylesheet function or global variable (each lowering enters and leaves its own function, so nothing is left half-open). Nothing is lowered once reading reported an error, and no unit is made once lowering did. An error that stops a stage (a dynamic error of a static expression, the in-scope schemas, outputs, streamability) goes to the sink too, once. The record holds the first error.

Users: sxml transform gives the sink a receiver that writes each error as the one line it always wrote (FILE:LINE:COLUMN: CODE: description) and exits 1 after the compilation; Schematron () passes its own sink to sxml_xslt_stylesheet_create_from_ast; the JavaScript compileStylesheet keeps throwing the first error and adds every report (reports).
Not done: errors inside one template rule after its first (a template is one unit of lowering); errors of included modules that are not well-formed stop reading as before.

Evidence: xslt_test report_sink_receives_every_compile_error (four reading errors in three declarations, three analysis errors in two template rules and a function, the null sink giving the first); CLI tests transform_compile_errors, transform_analysis_errors. XT40, release, case by case against the base commit built the same way: 0 outcomes differ (12,185 passed).
